ALL.description: Designates all axes supported by the controller.

I.description: General-purpose integer array. Supports explicit and postfix indexing, such as I(99) and I99.

V.description: General-purpose real array. Supports explicit and postfix indexing, such as V(0) and V0.

LCI.description: Standard laser-control interface structure. Provides laser functions and configuration/state fields.

AUTOEXEC.description: Power-up entry label. Execution starts here when the controller powers up.

INT.description: Declares a 32-bit integer variable or an integer function return type.

REAL.description: Declares a real variable or a real function return type.

LOCAL.description: Declares variables local to the program buffer.

GLOBAL.description: Declares variables shared between program buffers.

MATRIX.description: Declares a square matrix: a two-dimensional REAL array.

STRUCT.description: Defines a composite data type in the D-buffer.

VOID.description: Function return type indicating no returned value.

REF.description: Passes an INT or REAL function parameter by reference.

FASTCALL.description: Declares a function that executes in a single controller cycle.

TAG.description: Associates user variables with a tag number for GETVAR and SETVAR.

RET.description: Returns from a subroutine, autoroutine or user-defined function.

END.description: Closes a BLOCK, IF, LOOP or WHILE control structure.

ENDS.description: Closes a segmented or multipoint motion definition.

HALTALL.description: Terminates motions on all axes using a third-order deceleration profile.

PTP.description: Generates point-to-point motion for the specified axis or axes to a specified destination point.
signatures: PTP[switches] axis_list, destination_point [, velocity, end_velocity, motor_movement_delay]
parameters: axis_list: A single axis or an axis group.
end_velocity: Optional destination velocity used with /f.

switches.name: e
switches.description: Wait for motion termination before executing the next command.

switches.name: f
switches.description: Specify non-zero velocity at the destination point.

switches.name: m
switches.description: Use the motion profile values of the axis group as a whole.

switches.name: r
switches.description: Destination is relative to the start point.

switches.name: v
switches.description: Use the specified velocity instead of VEL.

switches.name: w
switches.description: Create motion but wait for GO before starting.

switches.name: q
switches.description: Delay actual motor movement; resolution is 50 microseconds.

DISP.description: Builds an ASCII output string and sends it to the default communication channel defined by DISPCH.
parameters: argument: An expression or a string enclosed in double quotation marks.
Strings support text, escape sequences (\r, \s, \n, \t, \xHH), and format specifiers.

FPOS.description: Feedback position of each motor in user-defined units. One array element per axis. Read-only.

MST.description: Motor state. An integer array containing motor-state bits, one element per axis.

#MOVE.description: Motion-state bit 5. AST.#MOVE indicates the axis is involved in motion; MST.#MOVE indicates motor motion. For example: TILL ^MST(0).#MOVE.

DPM_Measurement.description: Diagnostic measurement structure that configures sampling and stores process or periodic measurement results.

DPM_Motion_Status.description: Diagnostic structure that monitors the motion phase of a selected axis.

MotionDuration.description: Standard structure that calculates overall and individual motion-phase durations in seconds from motion parameters. Calculation functions execute in program buffers and wait until calculation completes.

BSEG.description: Starts a blended segmented motion sequence terminated by ENDS. Specifies the initial positions and segment, acceleration and jerk times.
signatures: BSEG[switches](axis_list), initial_position_axis1, initial_position_axis2, segment_time, acceleration_time, jerk_time [, dwell_time] [, motor_motion_delay]

LCZone.description: Configures a laser-control operation zone along a single-axis or multi-axis trajectory. Laser pulses are enabled only inside the specified position boundaries.
signatures: LCZONE(Index, AxesUsed, MinPosition, MaxPosition [, InitOffset, PulseResolution])

NURBS.description: Creates a non-uniform rational B-spline motion. Control points are added using NPOINT and the motion definition is closed with ENDS.
signatures: NURBS[switches](axis_list) [, velocity, deviation, exc_angle, exc_length, segments_buffer, motor_motion_delay]

switches.name: w
switches.description: Wait for GO before starting motion.

switches.name: d
switches.description: Specify permitted deviation from the spline.

switches.name: a
switches.description: Specify the maximum angle exception at a control point.

switches.name: q
switches.description: Delay actual motor movement; resolution is 50 microseconds.
